source._comment: STAGED SKELETON -- checked 2026-10-14, no feed found. www.elections.ny.gov sits fully behind a Cloudflare JS challenge ('Just a moment...' interstitial) for every page, including EarlyVoting.html -- confirmed via direct fetch (both a plain and a browser-header-spoofed request got HTTP 403 with the Cloudflare challenge body), so there is no way to pull its daily early-voting-by-county report without a real browser. Checked data.ny.gov (the state's own Socrata open-data portal) directly, scoped to domains=data.ny.gov: no early-voting, turnout, or ballot dataset exists there at all (only campaign-finance data matches 'election'). A generic cross-domain Socrata catalog search surfaces a dataset called 'Early Voting by Day in General Elections 2008-2026' but its metadata.domain is data.macoupincountyil.gov (an unrelated Illinois county portal, unofficial, statewide-total-only, no county breakdown) -- not usable. NY's actual 2026 general early-voting window is ~Oct 24-Nov 1 (general_start corrected above from the generic 10-15 placeholder). Re-check once that window opens: news coverage in past cycles cites 'state Board of Elections figures' directly, suggesting NYSBE does release numbers (possibly via press PDF) even though the web UI is Cloudflare-walled -- worth checking for a direct PDF/data link bypassing the challenged pages, or whether NYC BOE (a different domain, covers only the 5 NYC counties) exposes something fetchable. Until then this reads 0.
